ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; remind the driver that "I'm Here" only supports a no-show cancellation after >3 minutes of continuous waiting at the pickup point.
ruling.reasoning:
Cancellation was by the driver and he relies on rider no-show, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1(i): arrival confirmation was a driver tap — "I'm Here" at 14:14:10 [F6], 41 m from pickup [F6]. NS-1(ii) is satisfied (≤200 m at tap) [F6].
NS-1(iii) fails: the driver must wait continuously >3 minutes at the pickup point after the tap. He tapped at 14:14:10 and cancelled at 14:15:50 [F4][F6] — only 1 min 40 s within 200 m after the tap [F6]. Even measuring from the platform-recorded arrival at 14:13:25, the total within-200 m time before cancellation is 2 min 25 s [F2][F5], still under 3:01. His own chat message "3 min up, cancelling the trip" at 14:15 [F10] is wrong on the record; only 2 min 0 s of it was stationary [F3]. The record's free-wait time is not a no-show threshold (NS-1), and no record threshold overrides the 3-minute default here.

Since (iii) is not met, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is fully refunded. The (ii) condition is met, so no fraud flag under NS-2 is warranted, and RD-6 is not triggered (driver's one upheld no-show dispute is a prior event, not this case). GPS coverage is complete across the relevant window [F2][F3][F5], the chat is fully timestamped [F11], so no evidence gap.

Safety screen: chat [F9][F10], driver statement [F12] and the complaint contain no threat, abuse, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. No safety concern.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's chat claim '3 min up' does not match the record: the tap was at 14:14:10 and cancellation at 14:15:50 (1 min 40 s after the tap), and only 2 min 0 s of stationary time [F3]; cumulative within-200 m time was 2 min 25 s [F2]. System records (gps/timeline) override the statement.

Driver's post-trip statement that he waited and then cancelled as a no-show is a claim; NS-1(iii) requires >3 minutes of continuous waiting after the 'I'm Here' tap, which the GPS/timeline does not support.
